hero_subtitle: Explore how West Sussex County Council manages public money. £4.86B tracked across 930K transactions.
publisher_bio: This website was created by Tom Pickup, Reform UK county councillor for Padiham and Burnley West and Cabinet Member for Adult Social Care at Lancashire County Council. He is also parish councillor for Clowbridge with Dunnockshaw. Tom builds transparency tools that make public spending data easier to check.
publisher_titles: County Councillor for Padiham and Burnley West
Cabinet Member for Adult Social Care, Lancashire County Council
Parish Councillor for Clowbridge with Dunnockshaw
publisher_quote: It's your money. The more people understand where it goes, the better.

doge_context.political_control_summary: West Sussex CC is in no overall control after May 2026 elections — Liberal Democrats and Reform UK tied with 23 seats each (largest parties), Conservatives 11, Greens 7, Labour 5, Others 1. Conservatives lost overall control for the first time since 1997. First time Reform UK stood a full slate. Coalition negotiations ongoing.

political_control.tenure_note: NOC after May 2026; Lib Dems and Reform UK tied at 23 seats each. First Reform full-slate cycle.
